title: Without: a- and an-
short: In words from Greek, a- (an- before a vowel) means without or not.
trouble: a- means without only in Greek-based words (apathy, anarchy); in English words like asleep and aboard, a- means on or in.

blocks.html: Greek had its own “not” prefix: a-, written an- before a vowel. It means without or not. You know it from atypical (not typical) and anonymous (without a name: an- + onym, name).

blocks.html: a- and an- (Greek) = without, not. Use a- before a consonant (a-pathy) and an- before a vowel or h (an-archy, an-onymous).
Because it is a single letter, a- is easy to miss. Read the rest of the word first; if what is left is a Greek part you know (path, arch, morph), the a- or an- in front probably means “without.”

blocks.title: Use the parts
blocks.q: After years without use, the old trail atrophied into a faint line in the grass. What does atrophy mean?
steps: Literally: “without nourishment.” Something that is not fed or used gets weaker and smaller.
The sentence fits: an unused trail shrinks and fades.
blocks.a: To waste away from lack of use.

blocks.name: vo-word

entry.def: lack of interest, feeling or concern
entry.ex: The team’s {apathy} was plain: no one even came to the last practice.
entry.ctx: The club failed not because anyone opposed it but because of {apathy}; hardly anyone cared enough to come to meetings or to vote.
entry.etym: From Greek apatheia, “freedom from feeling”: a- (without) + pathos (feeling).

mn.text: The class garden is wilting in the sun, but everyone just shrugs and walks past: nobody cares. That is {apathy}.

blocks.html: a- means “without” only in words from Greek. In English words like asleep, aboard and afloat, the a- means “on” or “in” (on board, in sleep). And many words simply start with the letter a (apple, agree). Check that the rest of the word is a Greek part before you read a- as “without.”

A word with a story: an anecdote is a short personal story. The Greek word meant “things not given out,” that is, unpublished tales. That is why anecdotal evidence means evidence from personal stories rather than careful study.
